description: Per-cell telemetry from telemetry_raw. Traffic: real ([from BigDataChallenge contest](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/EGZHFV), ODbL 1.0). Topology and latency: synthetic/modeled. Not a real network.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT interval_start AS time, cell_id AS metric, "internet" AS value
FROM telemetry_raw
WHERE replay_run_id = '$run' AND site_id = '$site' AND cell_id IN ($cell)
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT interval_start AS time, cell_id AS metric, "latency_ms" AS value
FROM telemetry_raw
WHERE replay_run_id = '$run' AND site_id = '$site' AND cell_id IN ($cell)
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
ORDER BY 1, 2
